examples.hanzi: 这种药饭后服用效果最好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào fàn hòu fúyòng xiàoguǒ zuì hǎo.
examples.english: This medicine works best when taken after meals.

examples.hanzi: 孕妇不能随便服用这类药物。
examples.pinyin: Yùnfù bù néng suíbiàn fúyòng zhè lèi yàowù.
examples.english: Pregnant women shouldn't take this kind of medicine casually.

examples.hanzi: 为了赶上末班车，他不惜跑了两站路。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎn shàng mòbānchē, tā bùxī pǎo le liǎng zhàn lù.
examples.english: To catch the last bus, he didn't hesitate to run for two stops.

examples.hanzi: 她不惜花很多钱给孩子请好老师。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùxī huā hěn duō qián gěi háizi qǐng hǎo lǎoshī.
examples.english: She spares no expense to hire good teachers for her child.

examples.hanzi: 别发火，我们慢慢说。
examples.pinyin: Bié fāhuǒ, wǒmen mànmàn shuō.
examples.english: Don't lose your temper, let's talk it through slowly.

examples.hanzi: 他很少发火，大家都觉得他脾气好。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn shǎo fāhuǒ, dàjiā dōu juéde tā píqi hǎo.
examples.english: He rarely gets angry, and everyone thinks he is good-tempered.

examples.hanzi: 吃饭以前，他低头祷告了一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Chīfàn yǐqián, tā dītóu dǎogào le yíhuìr.
examples.english: Before eating, he bowed his head and prayed for a moment.

examples.hanzi: 大家一起为病人祷告，希望他早日康复。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yìqǐ wèi bìngrén dǎogào, xīwàng tā zǎorì kāngfù.
examples.english: Everyone prayed for the patient, hoping for a quick recovery.

examples.hanzi: 服务员，请把菜单拿给我们。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng bǎ càidān ná gěi wǒmen.
examples.english: Waiter, please bring us the menu.

examples.hanzi: 这家酒店的服务员态度非常好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fúwùyuán tàidù fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: The staff at this hotel have a very good attitude.

examples.hanzi: 你在犹豫什么？快做决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài yóuyù shénme? Kuài zuò juédìng ba.
examples.english: What are you hesitating about? Just make a decision.

examples.hanzi: 他毫不犹豫地跳进水里救人。
examples.pinyin: Tā háo bù yóuyù de tiào jìn shuǐ lǐ jiù rén.
examples.english: He jumped into the water to save someone without hesitation.

examples.hanzi: 他们相信友谊是永恒的。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xiāngxìn yǒuyì shì yǒnghéng de.
examples.english: They believe friendship is everlasting.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌表达了对永恒爱情的向往。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē biǎodá le duì yǒnghéng àiqíng de xiàngwǎng.
examples.english: This song expresses a longing for eternal love.

examples.hanzi: 从此，他再也没有迟到过。
examples.pinyin: Cóngcǐ, tā zài yě méiyǒu chídào guo.
examples.english: From then on, he was never late again.

examples.hanzi: 她搬到了北京，从此开始了新的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā bān dào le Běijīng, cóngcǐ kāishǐ le xīn de shēnghuó.
examples.english: She moved to Beijing and started a new life from then on.

examples.hanzi: 有人愿意出价买这辆旧车吗？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yuànyì chūjià mǎi zhè liàng jiù chē ma?
examples.english: Is anyone willing to bid on this old car?

examples.hanzi: 他出价太低，卖家不同意。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūjià tài dī, màijiā bù tóngyì.
examples.english: His bid was too low, and the seller didn't agree.

examples.hanzi: 我每天下午四点放学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān xiàwǔ sì diǎn fàngxué.
examples.english: I get out of school at four every afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 放学以后，我们一起去买冰淇淋吧。
examples.pinyin: Fàngxué yǐhòu, wǒmen yìqǐ qù mǎi bīngqílín ba.
examples.english: After school, let's go buy ice cream together.

examples.hanzi: 我祖父今年已经八十岁了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǔfù jīnnián yǐjīng bāshí suì le.
examples.english: My grandfather is already eighty this year.

examples.hanzi: 祖父每天早上都要打太极拳。
examples.pinyin: Zǔfù měi tiān zǎoshang dōu yào dǎ tàijíquán.
examples.english: My grandfather does tai chi every morning.

examples.hanzi: 我先走了，回见！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zǒu le, huíjiàn!
examples.english: I'm off now, see you later!

examples.hanzi: 明天下午三点，我们回见。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn, wǒmen huíjiàn.
examples.english: See you again tomorrow at three in the afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 懒惰是他最大的弱点。
examples.pinyin: Lǎnduò shì tā zuì dà de ruòdiǎn.
examples.english: Laziness is his biggest weakness.

examples.hanzi: 对手很快就发现了我们的弱点。
examples.pinyin: Duìshǒu hěn kuài jiù fāxiàn le wǒmen de ruòdiǎn.
examples.english: The opponent soon found our weak point.

examples.hanzi: 他喜欢搞恶作剧，大家都被他吓过。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan gǎo èzuòjù, dàjiā dōu bèi tā xià guo.
examples.english: He likes playing pranks, and everyone has been scared by him.

examples.hanzi: 这只是个恶作剧，别当真。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì ge èzuòjù, bié dàngzhēn.
examples.english: It's just a prank, don't take it seriously.

examples.hanzi: 我从网上下载了一首歌。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng wǎng shàng xiàzǎi le yì shǒu gē.
examples.english: I downloaded a song from the internet.

examples.hanzi: 下载速度太慢了，怎么办？
examples.pinyin: Xiàzǎi sùdù tài màn le, zěnme bàn?
examples.english: The download speed is too slow, what should I do?

examples.hanzi: 我们的蜜月旅行去了海边。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de mìyuè lǚxíng qù le hǎibiān.
examples.english: We went to the seaside on our honeymoon.

examples.hanzi: 他们刚结婚，正在度蜜月。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen gāng jiéhūn, zhèngzài dù mìyuè.
examples.english: They just got married and are on their honeymoon.

examples.hanzi: 如果你不满意，可以向公司投诉。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù mǎnyì, kěyǐ xiàng gōngsī tóusù.
examples.english: If you're not satisfied, you can file a complaint with the company.

examples.hanzi: 邻居因为噪音投诉了我们。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yīnwèi zàoyīn tóusù le wǒmen.
examples.english: Our neighbor complained about us because of the noise.

examples.hanzi: 公司给雇员提供免费午餐。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi gùyuán tígōng miǎnfèi wǔcān.
examples.english: The company offers its employees free lunch.

examples.hanzi: 这位雇员已经工作了十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gùyuán yǐjīng gōngzuò le shí nián.
examples.english: This employee has worked for ten years.

examples.hanzi: 月亮升起来了，星星也出来了。
examples.pinyin: Yuèliang shēng qǐlái le, xīngxing yě chūlái le.
examples.english: The moon has risen and the stars have come out too.

examples.hanzi: 中秋节的月亮最圆。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang zuì yuán.
examples.english: The moon at Mid-Autumn Festival is the roundest.

examples.hanzi: 这张桌子是很好的家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì hěn hǎo de jiājù.
examples.english: This table is a fine piece of furniture.

examples.hanzi: 我们想买一些新家具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng mǎi yìxiē xīn jiājù.
examples.english: We would like to buy some new furniture.

examples.hanzi: 他在一家大企业工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā dà qǐyè gōngzuò.
examples.english: He works at a large company.

examples.hanzi: 小企业需要政府的支持。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo qǐyè xūyào zhèngfǔ de zhīchí.
examples.english: Small businesses need the government's support.

examples.hanzi: 狮子是草原上的王者。
examples.pinyin: Shīzi shì cǎoyuán shàng de wángzhě.
examples.english: The lion is the king of the grassland.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们很喜欢看狮子表演。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen hěn xǐhuan kàn shīzi biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: The children love watching the lions perform.

examples.hanzi: 祝你旅途愉快！
examples.pinyin: Zhù nǐ lǚtú yúkuài!
examples.english: Have a pleasant trip!

examples.hanzi: 漫长的旅途中，他一直在看书。
examples.pinyin: Màncháng de lǚtú zhōng, tā yìzhí zài kàn shū.
examples.english: During the long journey, he kept reading.

examples.hanzi: 比赛进入了高潮，观众都站了起来。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jìnrù le gāocháo, guānzhòng dōu zhàn le qǐlái.
examples.english: The match reached its climax, and the audience all stood up.

examples.hanzi: 晚会在歌声中达到了高潮。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì zài gēshēng zhōng dádào le gāocháo.
examples.english: The party reached its peak with the singing.

examples.hanzi: 孩子应该服从老师的安排。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yīnggāi fúcóng lǎoshī de ānpái.
examples.english: Children should follow the teacher's arrangements.

examples.hanzi: 少数要服从多数。
examples.pinyin: Shǎoshù yào fúcóng duōshù.
examples.english: The minority should defer to the majority.

examples.hanzi: 他是一个真诚的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge zhēnchéng de péngyou.
examples.english: He is a sincere friend.

examples.hanzi: 请接受我真诚的感谢。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jiēshòu wǒ zhēnchéng de gǎnxiè.
examples.english: Please accept my sincere thanks.

examples.hanzi: 他有一个坚定的信念：努力一定有回报。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yí ge jiāndìng de xìnniàn: nǔlì yídìng yǒu huíbào.
examples.english: He has a firm belief that hard work will pay off.

examples.hanzi: 没有信念，就很难坚持下去。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu xìnniàn, jiù hěn nán jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.english: Without conviction, it's hard to keep going.

examples.hanzi: 你们都住嘴，听老师说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen dōu zhùzuǐ, tīng lǎoshī shuō.
examples.english: All of you be quiet and listen to the teacher.

examples.hanzi: 他被弟弟气得大喊：“住嘴！”
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi dìdi qì de dà hǎn: “Zhùzuǐ!”
examples.english: His younger brother made him so angry that he shouted, “Shut up!”

examples.hanzi: 我们住在大楼的第八层。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài dàlóu de dì bā céng.
examples.english: We live on the eighth floor of the building.

examples.hanzi: 这是我第八次来这里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì bā cì lái zhèlǐ.
examples.english: This is my eighth time here.

examples.hanzi: 这个老家伙很会讲笑话。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎojiāhuo hěn huì jiǎng xiàohua.
examples.english: This old guy is good at telling jokes.

examples.hanzi: 别看他是个老家伙，跑得可快了。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn tā shì ge lǎojiāhuo, pǎo de kě kuài le.
examples.english: Don't let his age fool you, that old fellow runs fast.

examples.hanzi: 火焰把整个山谷都照亮了。
examples.pinyin: Huǒyàn bǎ zhěng ge shāngǔ dōu zhàoliàng le.
examples.english: The flames lit up the whole valley.

examples.hanzi: 炉子里的火焰越来越小。
examples.pinyin: Lúzi lǐ de huǒyàn yuè lái yuè xiǎo.
examples.english: The flame in the stove is getting smaller and smaller.

examples.hanzi: 这个周末有一场免费的音乐会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng miǎnfèi de yīnyuèhuì.
examples.english: There is a free concert this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 我想和你一起去听音乐会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yìqǐ qù tīng yīnyuèhuì.
examples.english: I'd like to go to a concert with you.

examples.hanzi: 冰箱里的温度应该保持在四度左右。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de wēndù yīnggāi bǎochí zài sì dù zuǒyòu.
examples.english: The temperature in the fridge should stay at around four degrees.

examples.hanzi: 你先量一下体温，看看温度正不正常。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān liáng yíxià tǐwēn, kànkan wēndù zhèng bu zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Take your body temperature first and see if it is normal.

examples.hanzi: 天气极度干燥，容易发生火灾。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì jídù gānzào, róngyì fāshēng huǒzāi.
examples.english: The weather is extremely dry, so fires break out easily.

examples.hanzi: 他极度需要一个安静的环境。
examples.pinyin: Tā jídù xūyào yí ge ānjìng de huánjìng.
examples.english: He badly needs a quiet environment.

examples.hanzi: 电话打了很多次，终于接通了。
examples.pinyin: Diànhuà dǎ le hěn duō cì, zhōngyú jiētōng le.
examples.english: After many tries, the call finally went through.

examples.hanzi: 电源接通后，机器就开始工作。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán jiētōng hòu, jīqì jiù kāishǐ gōngzuò.
examples.english: Once the power is connected, the machine starts working.

examples.hanzi: 这个公园是市民休闲的好地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán shì shìmín xiūxián de hǎo dìfang.
examples.english: This park is a great place for city residents to relax.

examples.hanzi: 许多市民在广场上跳舞。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō shìmín zài guǎngchǎng shàng tiàowǔ.
examples.english: Many townspeople dance in the square.

examples.hanzi: 他深深地爱着这片土地。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēnshēn de àizhe zhè piàn tǔdì.
examples.english: He loves this land deeply.

examples.hanzi: 这件事给我留下了深深的印象。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì gěi wǒ liúxià le shēnshēn de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: This left a deep impression on me.

examples.hanzi: 青少年需要充足的睡眠。
examples.pinyin: Qīngshàonián xūyào chōngzú de shuìmián.
examples.english: Teenagers need enough sleep.

examples.hanzi: 这本书是为青少年写的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì wèi qīngshàonián xiě de.
examples.english: This book was written for young people.

examples.hanzi: 皇家卫队每天换岗一次。
examples.pinyin: Huángjiā wèiduì měi tiān huàngǎng yí cì.
examples.english: The royal guard changes shifts once a day.

examples.hanzi: 他们在皇家饭店举办了婚礼。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài Huángjiā Fàndiàn jǔbàn le hūnlǐ.
examples.english: They held their wedding at the Royal Hotel.

examples.hanzi: 他因为接受贿赂被开除了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jiēshòu huìlù bèi kāichú le.
examples.english: He was fired for accepting a bribe.

examples.hanzi: 有人想用金钱来贿赂裁判。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xiǎng yòng jīnqián lái huìlù cáipàn.
examples.english: Someone tried to bribe the referee with money.

examples.hanzi: 我基本上同意你的看法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīběnshang tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.english: I basically agree with your view.

examples.hanzi: 基本上每个周末我都去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Jīběnshang měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu qù páshān.
examples.english: Basically every weekend I go hiking.

examples.hanzi: 他把地图在桌子上展开了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dìtú zài zhuōzi shàng zhǎnkāi le.
examples.english: He spread the map out on the table.

examples.hanzi: 两位老师就这个问题展开了讨论。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi lǎoshī jiù zhège wèntí zhǎnkāi le tǎolùn.
examples.english: The two teachers launched a discussion on this issue.

examples.hanzi: 歌手在后台化妆，准备上台。
examples.pinyin: Gēshǒu zài hòutái huàzhuāng, zhǔnbèi shàngtái.
examples.english: The singer is putting on makeup backstage, getting ready to go on.

examples.hanzi: 听说他的后台很硬，没人敢得罪他。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō tā de hòutái hěn yìng, méi rén gǎn dézuì tā.
examples.english: They say he has strong backing, so nobody dares to offend him.

examples.hanzi: 我们去唱卡拉OK吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù chàng kǎlā OK ba.
examples.english: Let's go sing karaoke.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸最喜欢在卡拉OK里唱老歌。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zuì xǐhuan zài kǎlā OK lǐ chàng lǎo gē.
examples.english: Dad loves singing old songs at karaoke.

examples.hanzi: 他梦想有一天能拿到奥斯卡奖。
examples.pinyin: Tā mèngxiǎng yǒu yì tiān néng ná dào Àosīkǎ jiǎng.
examples.english: He dreams of winning an Oscar one day.

examples.hanzi: 奥斯卡颁奖典礼将在周日举行。
examples.pinyin: Àosīkǎ bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ jiāng zài zhōurì jǔxíng.
examples.english: The Oscars ceremony will be held on Sunday.

examples.hanzi: 我的电脑出了故障，开不了机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo chū le gùzhàng, kāi bù liǎo jī.
examples.english: My computer has a fault and won't start.

examples.hanzi: 工程师正在检查机器的故障。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài jiǎnchá jīqì de gùzhàng.
examples.english: The engineer is checking the machine's malfunction.

examples.hanzi: 商店正在出售各种旧书。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn zhèngzài chūshòu gèzhǒng jiù shū.
examples.english: The shop is selling all kinds of used books.

examples.hanzi: 这家店不出售烟酒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn bù chūshòu yānjiǔ.
examples.english: This shop does not sell cigarettes or alcohol.

examples.hanzi: 这条项链是用真金子做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàngliàn shì yòng zhēn jīnzi zuò de.
examples.english: This necklace is made of real gold.

examples.hanzi: 闪光的不一定都是金子。
examples.pinyin: Shǎnguāng de bù yídìng dōu shì jīnzi.
examples.english: All that glitters is not gold.

examples.hanzi: 那位伯爵很喜欢打猎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi bójué hěn xǐhuan dǎliè.
examples.english: The earl loved hunting.

examples.hanzi: 伯爵夫人在花园里招待客人。
examples.pinyin: Bójué fūrén zài huāyuán lǐ zhāodài kèrén.
examples.english: The countess entertained guests in the garden.

examples.hanzi: 童话里的女巫骑着扫帚飞行。
examples.pinyin: Tónghuà lǐ de nǚwū qízhe sàozhou fēixíng.
examples.english: The witch in the fairy tale flies on a broomstick.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们万圣节扮成了女巫。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen Wànshèngjié bàn chéng le nǚwū.
examples.english: The children dressed up as witches for Halloween.
